confidence: LOWER than the αvβ6 set. PD-L1 has NO linear motif, so these are NOT rule-enforced; they are design hypotheses toward the STRUCTURAL pharmacophore + the validated macrocyclic-peptide chemotype. They mean nothing until DOCKED against the PD-L1 IgV cleft. I did NOT copy WL12/dmp10/BMS sequences (not confident from memory; would be fabrication).
structural_pharmacophore_targeted: PD-L1 IgV front β-sheet face / hydrophobic cleft that PD-1 and antagonists engage (key PD-L1 residues incl. Tyr56, Met115, Ala121, Asp122 region). Validated chemotype = cyclic ~11-14-mer, AMPHIPATHIC with a hydrophobic/aromatic face into the cleft, D-amino-acid + N-methyl conformational lock (WL12 / BMS-986229 class / dmp10 disulfide-directed).
design_rule: cyclo( aromatic/hydrophobic cluster [F/W/Y/L/M/I] presented on one face + D-Pro/N-methyl lock + polar/charged residues on the opposite face for solubility/PK ); head-to-tail or disulfide-directed; length 10-13.

candidates.rationale: aromatic cluster to the hydrophobic cleft; polar S/D/T/K back face
deeper hydrophobic face (Met/Ile) mimicking small-molecule cleft engagement
three-aromatic face; Arg/Asp salt-bridge pair for rim contacts
maximal hydrophobic/aromatic face; minimal polar for cleft burial
candidates.liability_fix: HOLD: terminal Asp-Gly is the fastest isoAsp isomerisation hotspot. Root-cause fix: reorder tail to avoid D-G -> cyclo(F-L-W-[dP]-M-Y-[NMeS]-K-G-D); additionally M->Nle (norleucine) removes the Met-oxidation liability.

candidates.rationale: longer macrocycle (BMS-class length ~12) with extended amphipathic face
extra D-Phe cap for rigidity/protease resistance (macrocyclic-peptide style)
aromatic+aliphatic face; Glu/Arg for interface-rim electrostatics
DISULFIDE-DIRECTED scaffold (dmp10-like) instead of head-to-tail — tests the other validated PD-L1 chemotype

flags: [soft] sar:aggregation: hydrophobic fraction 0.80 > 0.60 -> aggregation / poor solubility risk (amphipathic is wanted, all-hydrophobic is not)

required_gates: DOCK vs PD-L1 IgV front-face cleft (rank by pose/ΔG) — this is THE gate; sequence cannot rule these in
similarity to the validated PD-L1 binder set (WL12/dmp10/BMS) pulled from primary refs — scaffold prior + novelty
pushback_on_audit: The audit said PD-L1 can only be docked, not templated. These show it IS templatable in method — a hydrophobic-face amphipathic macrocycle with a lock is a concrete, non-random chemotype (vs the old A-03/A-07/A-09/A-10 protein-fragment-like L-cyclic peptides). But docking remains the decisive gate; agreement with the audit that sequence alone cannot validate PD-L1.
